SELECT match_history.id as matchHistoryId, match_history.match_date as matchDate, club.id as awayClubId, club.image_url as imageUrl, club.club_name as clubName, club.university as university, match_history.location as location, match_history.match_type as matchType, match_history.result as result FROM match_history JOIN club on club.id = match_history.away_club_id WHERE 1=1 AND match_history.deleted = false AND match_history.home_club_id = #{clubId} AND match_history.is_official = true
AND (club.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{listReqDto.keyword}, '%') OR club.university LIKE CONCAT('%', #{listReqDto.keyword}, '%') OR match_history.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{listReqDto.keyword}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(match_history.match_date, '%Y.%m.%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{listReqDto.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY match_history.match_date DESC, match_history.id DESC
